outcome: Incidence of type 1 diabetes (T1D) in young children (<10 years)
cohort: 1,478,573 live births born in Taiwan between 2000 and 2005
finding: Childhood infection, younger maternal age, older paternal age, Caesarean section delivery, gestational diabetes mellitus, and paternal history of type 1 or type 2 diabetes were associated with an increased risk of T1D in young children.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of type 1 diabetes in young children (OR = 2.35, 95% CI = 1.52-3.64).
